mainbody.caption: Main body

pageimage.caption: Teaser image

teasertext.help: Can be used to display a text other than the description when the page is dropped in a content area

opengraphimageurl.caption: Open Graph image URL
opengraphimageurl.help: Direct URL to an image used for social sharing

opengraphtype.help: Type of the object (eg. website, article)

opengraphsitename.caption: Open Graph site name
